purpose: Select exactly one economically distinct offline three-session factor after terminal Campaign088, before opening any Campaign089 minute source row, candidate value, comparison value, daily price, or forward return.

candidate_design_catalog.reason: It measures whether transaction amount attached to positive within-half close returns arrives later in the completed session than amount attached to negative returns. The conditional timing spread is distinct from unsigned amount timing, total positive-direction amount share, return magnitude weighting, and fixed late-window selection.

The point-in-time operating cash conversion mechanism and nearby cash-flow/self-funding variants already have immutable terminal records. Reopening them would be a prohibited rescue rather than a new Campaign089 mechanism.
Choosing an association estimator, an activity threshold, or a sign-state table would search alternatives around exposed amount-direction and amount-return dependence families.
Both direct marginal mechanisms already exist in the complete library; changing direction, transform, or spelling is not a new factor.
Subwindows, return-magnitude weights, activity thresholds, ranks, smoothing, filters, regimes, fitted weights, models, and combinations are outside the one-factor finite catalog.

selected_candidate.name: intraday_directional_amount_timing_spread_238m
selected_candidate.economic_hypothesis: When transaction amount attached to upward one-minute price changes migrates later in the completed session than amount attached to downward changes, the close reflects a late shift toward buy-side participation that may continue over the next three sessions.
selected_candidate.formula: Form 119 adjacent log-close returns separately inside each 120-close half, yielding 238 returns. Associate each return with its destination-bar amount and assign chronological ordinal u_k=k/237 for k=0,...,237 across the pooled morning-then-afternoon return positions. Let U=sum amount_k*1[return_k>0], D=sum amount_k*1[return_k<0], T_up=sum u_k*amount_k*1[return_k>0]/U, and T_down=sum u_k*amount_k*1[return_k<0]/D. Return T_up-T_down.
selected_candidate.time_grid: Exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00. Returns are formed only within each half, so destination amounts are 09:32-11:30 and 13:02-15:00. The 238 return positions are ordered morning first and afternoon second solely for the fixed session-time coordinate. The raw 09:30 row is required by source identity but excluded; no lunch, overnight, cross-day, or cross-stock return is formed.
selected_candidate.input_rule: Every selected close must be finite and strictly positive. Every one of the 238 destination amounts must be finite and nonnegative. Exact zero returns and zero amounts remain valid observations and are not dropped from source support.
selected_candidate.support_rule: Require all 238 returns, strictly positive finite U, and strictly positive finite D. Exact zero-return amount contributes to neither directional mass. No epsilon, pseudocount, minimum count, threshold, or replacement is used.
selected_candidate.floating_point_rule: Use natural-log float64 arithmetic and the exact rational clock coordinate k/237. Require the final score to be finite in [-1,1]; canonicalize only values within 1e-12 of either endpoint or zero.
selected_candidate.availability: Known at the signal-session close after the exact 240 selected closes and 238 destination amounts; no later session, daily return, comparison value, or Candidate49 observation is used.

decision.required_next_step: Complete and bind one exhaustive no-value mechanism-overlap audit; then freeze the no-return protocol, implementation, tests, and fingerprints before any candidate value.
